title: GTA 6 Release Date: Why Rockstar Skipped a GTA 5.5
description: The GTA 6 release date is November 19, and Rockstar says it skipped a quicker GTA 5.5 to take big swings, according to GameSpot's latest report.

body.text: The GTA 6 release date is locked in for November 19, and Rockstar has now explained why it took so long. According to GameSpot, a Rockstar publishing executive says the studio could have shipped a quicker "GTA 5.5" but chose not to. For anyone who has waited years for this game, it shows what the studio was aiming for.
GameSpot cites Rockstar publishing executive Jennifer Kolbe, who told The Guardian that the team "could have made GTA 5.5, and done it faster." She added that this was not what the developers wanted.
Rockstar boss Rob Nelson backed that up. He said the studio has to "take big swings" and that the game "can't be just more of the same."

Take-Two, Rockstar's owner, framed the long wait as a hunt for perfection. Per GameSpot, the company said Rockstar wants to do something that has never been done before, and that this is hard and slow.
GameSpot says GTA 6 looks like a big step up from GTA 5, including better visuals and technical improvements. The story follows a Bonnie-and-Clyde-style crime-loving couple, Jason and Lucia.
It is also the first GTA game with a playable female protagonist, according to the report.
GTA 6 release date, platforms and unlock time

items: Platforms: PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, per GameSpot.
Unlock: midnight local time, not at one global moment, so the US will be among the last regions to play.
Fun side note: GameSpot reports that people in Australia can attend a funeral at KFC to get the day off work.

body.text: The report only names the two consoles above, so check the platform stores for anything beyond that.
Will future GTA games come faster?

Rockstar and Take-Two stand to gain a lot from what is expected to be a commercial blockbuster. GameSpot asked whether later GTA releases might arrive faster. Take-Two boss Strauss Zelnick said the "nature and velocity" of GTA releases will look "dramatically different" over the next decade. He did not share details or commit to timelines, so treat any talk of a faster cadence as unconfirmed.

The big moment is launch day on November 19, when the midnight unlock rolls across regions and players find out whether the big swings paid off. After that, keep an eye on any word from Take-Two about what that different release pace for GTA will actually look like.

faqs.q: What is the GTA 6 release date?
faqs.a: According to GameSpot, Grand Theft Auto 6 launches on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.

faqs.q: Why did GTA 6 take so long to come out?
faqs.a: GameSpot reports that Take-Two says Rockstar is chasing perfection and trying to do something that has never been done before, which takes a long time. Rockstar boss Rob Nelson said the game could not be just more of the same.
GameSpot says GTA 6 unlocks at midnight local time rather than at the same moment worldwide. That means players in the US will be among the last to get it.

sources.title: Rockstar Could Have Released GTA 6 Sooner As GTA 5.5, But “You Have To Take Big Swings”
